exposure: Fear of health professionals' disrespect and abuse
Family decision on the place of delivery
Traditional birth attendants' acceptability by the community
cohort: The study participants included 20 women who had antenatal care but gave birth at home, and 10 healthcare providers and traditional birth attendants from selected health facilities in South Ethiopia.
finding: The primary reasons pregnant mothers in South Ethiopia prefer home delivery after attending antenatal care include fear of disrespect from health professionals, family influence on delivery location, financial and transport barriers, community acceptance of traditional birth attendants, and sociocultural factors.
